description: NaVAsO₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.77 Å. V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent VO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 32°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.72-2.05 Å. As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-57°. There are two shorter (1.72 Å) and two longer (1.73 Å) As-O bond lengths. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one V, and one As atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one V, and one As atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent V atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one V, and one As atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₂VAs tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one V, and one As atom.
